specs.Item Highlight: Bluetooth Headphones, Up to 60H Playtime, ENC, Fast Charging, Heavy Bass

features: Extended Battery Life: Enjoy up to 60 hours of continuous playtime, ensuring your music and calls last throughout your day without frequent recharging
Advanced Connectivity: Features the latest Bluetooth V5.4 technology for faster pairing, stable connection, and enhanced audio transmission quality
Crystal Clear Communication: ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) technology filters out background noise for clear and uninterrupted phone calls
Immersive Audio Experience: Powerful heavy bass sound delivers deep, rich audio quality that enhances your music, movies, and gaming sessions
Durable Design: Sweat and splash resistant construction protects your earbuds during workouts, outdoor activities, and daily use
description: Experience powerful sound, seamless connectivity, and all-day comfort with Aroma TWS1 Pulse V5.4 True Wireless Earbuds. Designed for music lovers, gamers, and professionals, these Bluetooth earbuds deliver crystal-clear calls, deep bass, and ultra-long battery life in a premium Shiny Gold finish.
